$comment: Low-end Android perf lab budgets (issue #778). Read by scripts/perf-lab.mjs. Change only with a rationale; see docs/perf-lab.md.

device.rationale: Approximates the entry-level Android phones (Moto E / Tecno Spark class) that CHWs and bystanders carry: ~4x slower than a dev laptop single-core, 2 GB RAM, slow-4G in peri-urban areas. 6x is the Lighthouse mobile convention on CI hardware.

longTaskCount.rationale: Each long task delays tap response for a responder; the card is mostly static HTML.

totalBlockingTimeMs.rationale: Lighthouse 'good' TBT on mobile is 200 ms at 4x; 6x CPU scales that to ~600 ms.

jsHeapUsedMb.rationale: Keeps headroom on 2 GB devices where Chrome kills background tabs aggressively.

longTaskCount.rationale: Offline load is served by the service worker and must be no heavier than online.

totalBlockingTimeMs.rationale: Same bar as the online card: responders hit this with no signal.

jsHeapUsedMb.rationale: Same as online; the SW cache must not inflate page memory.
